mentions.name: Churchit
mentions.description: This platform is a fully FOSS, self-hostable church management solution. It provides churches with a dynamic public website, a member portal, and a feature-rich management backend as an all-in-one package installable with minimal technical expertise.
mentions.audience: Churches that can self-host it with minimal technical expertise
mentions.source_excerpt:
A fully FOSS Church management platform called Churchit ( https://Churchit.app ).
Jesus once said "Freely you have received; even so freely give".
Churchit aims to be a comprehensive and feature rich all-in-one solution that churches can self-host with minimal technical expertise.
Churchit provides churches with a dynamic public website, a member portal, and a feature-rich management backend.
